User Story:
As a hirer I want to view list of venues, so that I can see the
 range of venues available for hire
Acceptance Criteria:
1.Given the hirer is on the venue browsing page, When the page loads, Then a list of
 venues available for hire is displayed.
 2. Given venues are available, When the hirer views the list, Then each venue shows
 its name, location, capacity, price, image, and short description.
 3. Given no venues are available, When the hirer opens the venue browsing page,
 Then the system displays a"No venues available" message.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to search a venue based on venue name,
 location, capacity, and recommended suitability, so that I
 can see a venue that is suitable for me
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer is on the venue browsing page, When the hirer selects or types a
 venue name, location, capacity, and recommended suitability in the location filter or
 any combinations of it, Then the system displays a list of matching venues for that
 specification.
 2. Given a specifc specification is entered, When no venues match the selected
 specificaation, Then the system displays a "No venues found" message.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to select my preffered venues and rank
 them, so that I can come back later and apply them
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer is viewing available venues, When the hirer selects a venue, Then
 the venue is added to their preferred venue list.
 2. Given the hirer is viewing their preferred venue list, When the hirer assigns or
 updates their ranking, Then the system saves and displays the venues in the chosen
 order.
 3. Given the hirer has saved preferred venues, When the hirer returns later, Then the
 system displays the previously saved venues and their rankings.
 4. Given the hirer has a saved preferred venue list, When the hirer chooses a venue to
 apply for,Then the system allows the hirer to continue to the application process.
 5. Given the hirer has not selected any venues, When the hirer opens the preferred
 venue list, Then the system shows a message that no preferred venues have been
 saved.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to submit an application to my selected
 venue, so that I can get a reply from the vendor
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer has selected a venue, When the hirer opens the application page,
 Then the system displays an application form for that venue.
 2. Given the hirer is completing the application form, When the hirer leaves a
 required field empty, Then the system prevents submission and displays a validation
 message.
 3. Given the hirer has completed all required application details, When the hirer
 submits the application, Then the system saves the application and displays a
 submission confirmation.
 4. Given the hirer has submitted an application, When the hirer views their dashboard
 later, Then the submitted application and its status are displayed.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to register my name, email and password,
 so that I can log in to the web app
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer opens the registration page, When the page loads, Then the system
 displays a registration form with first name, last name, email, password, and confirm
 password fields.
 2. Given the hirer is typing in the password or confirm password field, When
 characters are entered, Then the characters are hidden/masked.
 3. Given the hirer enters an email address, When the hirer submits the form, Then the
 system validates the email format and displays an error if the format is invalid.
 4. Given the hirer fills in the password and confirm password fields, When the hirer
 submits the form, Then the system validates that both fields match and displays an
 error if they do not.
 5. Given the hirer enters a password, When the hirer submits the form, Then the
 system validates that the password meets strong password requirements and
 displays an error if it does not.
 6. Given all fields are valid, When the hirer submits the form (by clicking submit or
 pressing enter), Then the system registers the account and navigates the hirer to the
 login page.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to log in using email and password, so that I
 can use the web app
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer is on the login page, When the hirer enters a matching email and
 password and submits, Then the system grants access and navigates the hirer to
 their dashboard.
 2. Given the hirer is on the login page, When the hirer enters an incorrect or
 mismatched email and/or password and submits, Then the system rejects the login
 attempt and displays an error message.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer is logged in, When the hirer opens the profile page, Then the system
 displays editable fields for name and phone number, and non-editable fields for
 email and password (as these were already registered during sign-up).
 2. Given the hirer updates their name or phone number, When the hirer saves the
 changes, Then the system updates and stores the new profile information and
 displays a confirmation message.
 3. Given the hirer enters invalid data (e.g., empty name or invalid phone number
 format), When the hirer attempts to save, Then the system prevents submission and
 displays a validation error message.
 4. Given the profile has been successfully updated, When the hirer returns to the
 profile page, Then the updated name and phone number are displayed.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to log out, so that I can close the app
 securely.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer is logged in, When the hirer clicks the "Log Out" button in the
 navigation bar or profile dropdown, Then the system signs the hirer out and displays a
 confirmation message (e.g., "You've been successfully logged out") before
 redirecting to the login page.
 2. Given the hirer has logged out, When the hirer attempts to access a protected page
 via the browser, Then the system redirects the hirer back to the login page.
 3. Given the hirer has logged out, When the hirer views the navigation bar, Then the
 profile option is no longer displayed.
 4. Given the hirer is logged in, When viewing any page, Then the "Log Out" button is
 accessible via the navigation bar or the profile dropdown menu.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to view my hiring reputation based on the
 historical list of previous bookings
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer is on their profile or dashboard, When the page loads, Then the
 system displays a list of previous bookings including pre-loaded sample data.
 2. Given the hirer has completed a successful new booking, When the hirer views
 their hiring reputation page, Then the new booking is listed alongside existing booking
 history.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to update my profile with compliant
 documents such as driver's license and public liability
 insurance as an uploaded file, so that my credibility
 improves
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer is uploading a compliant document includinig image, When the
 selected file size exceeds 2 MB, Then the system prevents the upload and displays a
 file size validation error.
 2. Given the hirer selects a file for upload, When the file type is not supported, Then
 the system prevents the upload and displays a file type validation error.
 3. Given the hirer uploads a PDF document, When the upload is successful, Then the
 system stores the file using IndexedDB or as a base64 string.
 4. Given the hirer uploads a non-PDF file, When the upload is successful, Then the
 system stores the file using localStorage.

User Story:
As both the hirer and vendor I want to see a hirer's credibility
 score based on the actual document submitted, so that I
 know my score which indicates the hirer's application
 chance of success
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer or vendor is viewing the hirer's profile, When the profile loads,
 Then the system displays the hirer's credibility score as a percentage or numerical
 value.
 2. Given one or more required documents are missing, when the system calculates
 the score,
 Then the missing document contributes 0% to the total score
 3. Given the hirer uploads or replaces a document, when the upload is successful,
 Then the system recalculates and updates the credibility score immediately.
 4. Given the hirer is logged in, when they view their profile or dashboard, then the
 credibility score is visible to them.

User Story:
As a vendor, I want to enter and update my profile details
 (name and phone number), so that my information is
 accurate and up to date.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is logged in, When the vendor opens the profile page, Then the
 system displays editable fields for name and phone number, and non-editable fields
 for email.
 2. Given the vendor updates their name or phone number, When the vendor saves the
 changes, Then the system updates and stores the new profile information.
 3. Given the vendor enters invalid data (e.g., empty name, invalid phone number),
 When the vendor attempts to save, Then the system prevents submission and
 displays a validation message.
 4.Given the profile is successfully updated, When the vendor returns to the profile
 page later, Then the updated information is displayed.

User Story:
As a hirer I want to make a booking by submitting
 application, so I can secure the venue for my event
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the hirer has selected a venue, When the hirer opens the
 booking/application page, system will display some information such as: event
 name, number of expected guests, and date, time and duration of proposed event.
 2. Given the hirer is completing the form, When the hirer leaves any required field
 empty, Then the system prevents submission and displays a clear validation
 message.
 3. Given the hirer has completed all required fields with valid data, When the hirer
 submits the application, Then the system saves the application and displays a
 confirmation message.

User Story:
As a vendor I want to view list of booking applications, so I
 can select the suitable hirer
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is logged in, When the vendor navigates to the applications page,
 Then the system displays all submitted applications in a list or similar view.
 2. Given applications are listed, When the vendor selects an application, Then the
 system displays the full details of that application.
 3. Given the vendor is reviewing an application, When the vendor chooses to act on it,
 Then the system provides options to accept or deny the application.

User Story:
As a vendor I want to view hirer's historical hire list, so I can
 judge their credibility and make decision about their
 application
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is logged in, When the vendor selects a hirer. Then the system
 shall display the hirer's historical hire list containing records/ rows showing venue
 name, location, event name, date of hire and star rating (out of 5). And last record
 showing total num of events, number of venue locations and average of star rating.
 2. Given the hirer has no past bookings, When the vendor views history.
 Then the system shall display "No past hiring history available"

User Story:
As a vendor I want to view hirer's compliant documents, so I
 can judge their credibility and make decision about their
 application
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is reviewing a hirer, When the vendor opens the hirer's profile.
 Then the system shall display uploaded compliant documents.
 2. Given documents are available, Then the system shall support viewing:
 Driver"s license (image)
 Insurance certificate (PDF)
 Business registration (PDF, if applicable)
 3. Given some documents are not uploaded, When the vendor views the profile. Then
 the system shall indicate missing documents clearly.
 4. Given documents are displayed, When the vendor reviews them. Then they should
 support assessing hirer credibility.

User Story:
As a vendor I want reject an application, so that I can find a
 better / more suitable hirer
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is reviewing an application, When the vendor selects the reject
 option, Then the system marks the application status as "Rejected" and updates the
 record accordingly.
 2. Given an application has been rejected, When the status is updated, Then the
 applicant is notified (if applicable) and the venue remains available for other
 incoming applications.

User Story:
As a vendor I want to accept an application for a venue at
 particular date and time, so I begin hiring transaction
 process
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is reviewing an application, When the vendor selects the accept
 option for a specific date and time, Then the system updates the application status to
 "Accepted" and initiates the hiring process.
 2. Given an application has been accepted, When the status is updated, Then the
 application status in the hirer page will be changed.

User Story:
As a vendor I want to block a venue availability period, so
 that no one can book it at that particular time period
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is managing venue availability, When the vendor selects a range
 of time to block a venue, Then the system saves the blocked period and prevents any
 bookings within that range.
 2. Given a period has been blocked, When any user views the venue availability or
 calendar, Then the blocked period is clearly indicated and cannot be overridden by
 hirers.
 3. Given the hirer submit an application, When the selected date/time conflicts with
 an unavailable or blocked period, Then the system prevents submission and displays
 "Selected date/time is unavailable."

User Story:
As a vendor I want to add comments on chosen hiring
 candidates, so that I can record notes and feedback about
 selected applicants
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor has accepted an application, When the vendor views the chosen
 candidate's booking details, Then the system displays a comment/notes input field
 associated with that candidate.
 2. Given the vendor enters a comment, When the vendor saves the comment, Then
 the system stores and displays the comment linked to that chosen candidate.
 3. Given the vendor has previously saved a comment, When the vendor revisits the
 chosen candidate's details, Then the previously saved comment is retrieved and
 displayed.
 4. Given the vendor edits an existing comment, When the vendor saves the updated
 comment, Then the system replaces the old comment with the new one and confirms
 the update.
 5. Given the comment field is empty, When the vendor attempts to save, Then the
 system either keeps the existing comment unchanged or saves an empty state
 without error.

User Story:
As a vendor I want to sort the applicants list by reputation
 score, so that I can quickly identify the most reliable hirers
Acceptance Criteria:
NOTE: All reputation scores are hardcoded.
 1. Given the vendor is viewing the list of applicants, When the vendor selects sort by
 reputation score, Then the system reorders the applicants from highest to lowest
 reputation score by default.
 2. Given an applicant has been rated by previous vendors on a 0-5 star scale, When
 the reputation score is calculated, Then the system displays the average star rating
 across all previous vendor ratings for that applicant.
 3. Given an applicant has no previous ratings, When the vendor views the sorted list,
 Then unrated applicants display a 'No rating' indicator and are positioned at the
 bottom of the sorted list.
 4. Given the vendor toggles the sort direction, When sorting by reputation score, Then
 the list updates to reflect ascending or descending order accordingly.
 5. Given the reputation score is displayed, When the vendor views any applicant in
 the list, Then the score is shown as a star rating between 0 and 5 stars alongside the
 applicant's name and other details.

User Story: As a vendor, I want to be give numerical ratings to hirers who have used my venues in the past
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is viewing the list of their venues, when selecting a specific venue to view, then the system should display all applicants for that venue and their ratings 
2. Given the vendor is viewing a list of applicants, when selecting a applicant profile, then the system should display an option to rate the user on a scale of one to five
3. Given the vendor has rated a user, when refreshing their page, then the system should display the user's updated averaged reviews

User Story:
As a vendor I want to see an infograph that shows the name
 of most chosen applicant, least chosen applicant, and failed
 applicants, so that I can better understand about my venues
 potential hirers
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Given the vendor is on the applicant charts page, When the page loads, Then the system
 displays an infographic showing the most chosen applicant, least chosen applicant,
 and failed applicants based on current application data.
 2. Given application data has been updated, When the vendor views the infographic, Then the information displayed accurately reflects the latest application
 results.

As a vendor I want to list my venue so that it is visible to me
 and hirers
Acceptance Criteria: Venue is entered, saved, and listed

Acceptance Criteria:

2. Given the vendor has confirmed the deletion, when the system processes the request, the system should remove the venue and all its associated bookings
3. Given a venue has been successfully deleted, when hirers view the venue list, the system should no longer display the deleted venue
